question: How much notice do I need to give to end my rental contract in Germany?
rule: Under section 573c of the German Civil Code (BGB), a tenant may terminate a residential lease with a notice period of three months.

question: How long does my landlord in France have to return my deposit?
rule: Under article 22 of French law no. 89-462 of 6 July 1989, a landlord must return the security deposit within one month of the return of the keys when the inventory on departure matches the inventory on arrival.

question: How much notice must a landlord in Finland give to end a lease?
rule: Under the Finnish Act on Residential Leases (481/1995), a landlord's notice period is three months if the tenancy has lasted less than a year and six months otherwise, while the tenant's notice period is one month.

question: How often can my landlord in New South Wales raise the rent?
rule: Under section 41 of the Residential Tenancies Act 2010 (NSW), a landlord must give at least 60 days' written notice of a rent increase, and rent may not be increased more than once in any 12-month period.

question: How much notice must my landlord in Victoria give before raising rent?
rule: Under section 44 of the Residential Tenancies Act 1997 (Victoria), a rental provider must give at least 60 days' notice of a rent increase, and rent cannot be increased more than once every 12 months.

question: How much notice must my landlord in Ontario give before raising the rent?
rule: Under section 116 of Ontario's Residential Tenancies Act, 2006, a landlord must give a tenant at least 90 days' written notice of a rent increase.

question: How much compensation do I get in Canada if my flight is 4 hours late?
rule: Under the Air Passenger Protection Regulations (SOR/2019-150), a large carrier must pay $400 in compensation for an arrival delay of three hours or more but less than six hours that is within its control.

question: How long do I have to return faulty goods in Ireland?
rule: Under the Consumer Rights Act 2022 (Ireland), a consumer has a short-term right to terminate a sales contract for goods that do not conform, exercisable within 30 days of delivery.

question: Can I make a company delete my personal data in the EU?
rule: Under Article 17 of the GDPR, the data subject has the right to obtain from the controller the erasure of personal data concerning him or her without undue delay.

question: Can I cancel a door-to-door sales contract in Japan?
rule: Under Japan's Act on Specified Commercial Transactions, a purchaser in a door-to-door sale may cancel the contract in writing within eight days of receiving the contract document.
